theorem_title: Scalar fields of a retained cover header
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostWantedRecordData.cover_scalars {μ : ℕ→ℤ} {cover h J : ℕ} (HC : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightCoverKeyData.Stored μ cover h J) :
    μ (cover+3)=(_root_.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.groupSize h : ℤ) ∧ μ (cover+6)=(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localPrime h : ℤ) ∧
      μ (cover+7)=(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localBucketCap h : ℤ) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, cover address $a$, and natural parameters $h,J$ satisfy the complete retained cover/key-data contract. Then its scalar header cells are

$$\mu(a+3)=G(h),\qquad\mu(a+6)=p(h),\qquad\mu(a+7)=B(h),$$

where $G(h)$ is the local representation count, $p(h)$ the selected local prime and $B(h)$ the independent bucket cap.

This connects actual header reads to the mathematical cover parameters used by wanted-record dispatch.
